UI_trait_DanDependentdesc:
Cannot go long without a drink.
A day dry brings craving, stress, low mood and poor sleep.
Two days dry brings pain, nausea and the shakes.
For a heavy drinker, three days dry brings hallucinations and seizures.
The deeper the habit, the sooner and harder it hits, and the more it takes to feel a drink.
A month without alcohol breaks it, but any drink after that risks a relapse.
Anyone who drinks too often can become an Alcoholic.
UI_trait_DanBrittledesc:
Bones give out easily.
Hard hits can fracture an arm, hand or leg.
Fractures must be splinted.
UI_trait_DanArthritisdesc:
Stiff, painful joints.
Hands and legs are always a little stiff: slower to move, slower to swing.
Cold and damp bring a flare: more pain, more stiffness.
Painkillers ease the ache, not the stiffness.
An unreliable grip: swings can throw the weapon to the ground, worse when panicked, hurt, tired or flaring.
UI_trait_DanJinxeddesc:
Luck is not on your side.
Containers looted for the first time nearby sometimes lose an item.
UI_trait_DanSpiralingdesc:
Depressive episodes hold mood down for days.
Pain, stress, exhaustion and time indoors bring them on.
Exercise, time outdoors, a drink, a smoke or comfort food ease them.
Antidepressants help after two weeks of daily use; stopping hurts.
UI_trait_DanBadDaydesc:
Everything went wrong this morning.
Starts blind drunk, with a cold, a shard of glass in the groin, no clothes and soaked.
If indoors, the house is on fire.
Applied once, to a new character.
UI_DanTraits_AlcoholicGained: You've come to need a drink
UI_DanTraits_AlcoholicRelapse: One drink was all it took
UI_trait_DanSchizophreniadesc:
Sees and hears things that are not there.
Phantom zombies, groans, thumps, whispers and breaking glass.
Sudden bouts of panic.
Worse when stressed, unhappy, tired or at night.
UI_trait_DanAsthmadesc:
Airways irritated by cold air, corpses, exertion and panic.
Builds from tight chest to wheezing, coughing and an attack.
Rest in clean, warm air clears it. Masks help.
A rescue inhaler cuts it back. Starts with one.
Cannot be taken with Asthmatic.
UI_trait_DanGlutendesc:
Wheat makes you ill.
Bread, pasta, cereal, pastry and beer bring cramps, nausea and low mood.
Worse the more you ate. Takes hours to clear.
UI_trait_DanVegetariandesc:
Does not eat animals.
Meat, fish, insects and dishes made with them are refused.
Eggs and dairy are fine.
UI_trait_DanDiabetes1desc:
Makes no insulin.
Blood sugar climbs with carbohydrates and on its own.
Only injected insulin brings it down.
Low: shakes, panic, dropped weapons. High: thirst, nausea, harm.
Starts with a glucose meter, test strips and insulin pens.
Cannot be taken with Type 2.
UI_trait_DanDiabetes2desc:
Body weight sets insulin resistance.
Blood sugar settles high and clears slowly when heavy.
Exercise, losing weight and metformin help.
Starts with a glucose meter, test strips and metformin.
Cannot be taken with Type 1.
UI_trait_DanRenFairedesc: Every summer at the faire turns out to have been training.
UI_trait_DanGymRegulardesc:
Keeps a training routine.
Every exercise starts at half regularity.
Applied once, to a new character.
UI_trait_DanCaffeinedesc:
Cannot function without caffeine.
Coffee, tea, cola, chocolate and caffeine pills all count.
Half a day without brings a headache, tiredness and low mood.
A week without breaks the habit.
UI_trait_DanMigrainedesc:
Prone to migraines.
Bad sleep, thirst, stress, hangovers and bright daylight bring them on.
An aura gives twenty minutes warning.
Hours of pain and nausea. Painkillers shorten it, daylight drags it out, sleep ends it sooner.
UI_trait_DanHemophiliadesc:
Blood does not clot.
Bleeding never stops on its own and costs far more health.
Open wounds bleed again until bandaged.
A scratch is a bandage or a slow death.
UI_trait_DanAnemiadesc:
Short of iron.
Without fresh meat, fish, greens, eggs or iron pills the deficit shows within days.
Endurance recovers slower, tiredness comes sooner, colds catch easier.
UI_trait_DanIronStomachdesc:
Can eat almost anything.
Rotten and burnt food does half the harm to your diet.
Food sickness climbs half as fast.
UI_trait_DanEarlyRiserdesc:
Up with the sun, and glad of it.
Starts well rested.
Every night counts for a little more.
Applied once, to a new character.
UI_trait_DanMealPrepperdesc:
Plans meals ahead.
Starts on a good diet.
Variety counts over five days instead of three.
Applied once, to a new character.
UI_trait_DanDeepSleeperdesc:
Sleeps like a rock.
Needs less sleep.
Light rarely wakes you, and costs less rest when it does not.
Sleeping in the dark does even more good.
Cannot be taken with Sleepyhead or Restless Sleeper.
UI_trait_DanAge20sdesc:
Young, and it shows.
No extra level in the profession's main skill.
Gym Regular starts at 65 regularity instead of 50.
Cannot be taken with Handy or Arthritis.
Without an age trait, a character is in their 30s: one extra level in the profession's main skill.
UI_trait_DanAge40sdesc:
Years on the job.
One extra level in the profession's main skill.
Handy gives one more level of Carpentry.
Arthritis flares sooner in the cold and damp.
Without an age trait, a character is in their 30s.
UI_trait_NightVisionDesc:
Better vision at night.
Light wakes you more easily.
UI_trait_SmokerDesc:
Cravings build between cigarettes, faster the heavier the habit.
Withdrawal brings irritability, hunger and restless sleep; a cigarette only relieves the craving it answers.
Damaged lungs: endurance recovers slower, and a cough that carries, worse on exertion and in the morning.
Three weeks without tobacco breaks the habit; nicotine gum eases the way. After that, a drink or a bad day brings the cravings back.
Anyone who smokes too often can become a Smoker.

UI_DanTraits_DressingSpent: The dressing on your %1 needs changing
UI_DanTraits_WoundOpened: The wound on your %1 opened up
UI_DanTraits_BadSet: The bone in your %1 isn't set right
UI_DanTraits_health_StitchesFresh: Stitches fresh, go easy on it
UI_DanTraits_ComeTo: You come round on the floor
UI_DanTraits_BloodComeTo: You come round, cold and shaking
UI_DanTraits_health_KnockToHead: Took a knock to the head
